text: Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited is the majority shareholder of Singtel: 50.57% of issued ordinary shares in Singtel's register of members (as at 2 June 2026, FY2026 Annual Report); the Singapore Exchange's company profile for Singtel also states it is majority-owned by Temasek.
short: Temasek holds a majority stake (50.57%) in Singtel.

source.name: Singtel Annual Report 2026: Shareholder Information (as at 2 June 2026), Major Shareholders List - Top 20
source.note: The register of substantial shareholders on the same page shows Temasek with 8,304,071,181 direct shares plus 234,305,969 deemed.

additionalSources.name: Singapore Exchange (SGX): corporate information page for Singapore Telecommunications Limited
additionalSources.quote: It is majority-owned (2019: 49.8 percent) by Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited.
additionalSources.note: SGX's background text (marked 'information last updated' 2026-09-29) confirms majority ownership by Temasek; the 49.8% figure is the exchange's 2019 number, while Singtel's own register shows 50.57% as at 2 June 2026.
